# Sacramento Property Solutions

> Local cash home buyer serving Sacramento, CA and the surrounding
> metro (Sacramento, Placer, Yolo, and El Dorado counties). We buy
> single-family homes, condos, townhomes, and small multifamily for
> cash, close in 7-30 days, and pay all closing costs. No agent
> commissions, no repair credits, no contingencies. Locally
> operated, funded with our own capital.

## Service area

Sacramento metro — Sacramento County primary, plus Placer, Yolo,
and El Dorado counties. Primary cities:

- Sacramento (95811-95838)
- Elk Grove (95624, 95757, 95758)
- Roseville (95661, 95678, 95746, 95747)
- Folsom (95630, 95762)
- Citrus Heights (95610, 95621)
- Rancho Cordova (95670, 95742, 95827)
- Davis (95616, 95618)
- West Sacramento (95605, 95691)

Other communities: Carmichael, Fair Oaks, Antelope, Galt, Wilton,
Granite Bay, Loomis, Rocklin, Lincoln, El Dorado Hills, Cameron
Park, Placerville, Woodland, Dixon, Plumas Lake.

## Offer terms

- Free, no-obligation written cash offer within 24 hours
- Close in as fast as 7 days, typical close 14-30 days
- Properties bought as-is — no repair credits, no inspection
  re-negotiations
- Sacramento Property Solutions pays all closing costs
- We use our own capital — no financing or appraisal contingencies
- Closing at a Sacramento, Placer, Yolo, or El Dorado County title
  company

## Seller situations we work with

- Pre-foreclosure (California is a non-judicial foreclosure state;
  Trustee's Sale process under CA Civil Code §§ 2924-2924k; typical
  4-month timeline; we close before auction)
- Inherited / probate houses (California Probate Code; Sacramento
  County Superior Court; full probate often 9-18 months; simplified
  procedures for estates under $184,500)
- Divorce sales (CA is community property; 6-month minimum waiting
  period; both parties cash out same date)
- Distressed / as-is properties (fire damage, flood damage,
  foundation issues from expansive clay soils, pool neglect,
  hoarding, long-vacant homes)
- State government employee relocations
- UC Davis Health, Sutter, Kaiser, Dignity medical professional moves
- Bay Area outflow / inflow (during and after telework wave)
- Out-of-state inheritances (entire transaction handled remotely)
- Tired landlords and investor exits

## When a cash sale is not the right choice

If the property is in good condition, the seller has time for a
60-90 day MLS listing, and there are no urgency factors — a
traditional listing will typically net more after costs.

## What we are not

We are not realtors. We do not list properties on the MLS. We are
a professional home-buying operation purchasing with our own funds.
